metadata.title: Multidisciplinary Approach to Antiplatelet Management in Coronary Syndromes: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association
top_takeaways: Antiplatelet management in acute coronary syndrome and chronic coronary disease requires individualized strategies balancing thrombotic risk reduction against bleeding risk.
Selection, intensity, and duration of antiplatelet therapy should be tailored according to patient-, procedure-, and disease-specific factors rather than applying a uniform approach.

Multidisciplinary cardiovascular team involvement—including interventional and general cardiologists, clinical pharmacists, and advanced practice nurses—is essential to support antithrombotic stewardship, optimize transitions of care, and improve adherence.

recommendations.statement: Tailor antiplatelet agent selection, intensity, and duration of therapy based on patient-, procedure-, and disease-specific factors to optimize the balance between thrombotic risk reduction and bleeding complications.
recommendations.target_population: Patients with acute coronary syndrome or chronic coronary disease
